PR46Start.body:
## 目的 / Purpose
根据用户确认的 [PR #44 统一 UI 设计](https://github.com/yudacheng666/SRM_System/pull/44)，直接升级正式 M1 Lite 页面（不是概念原型）。从开发基线 `f117cf3ca512a4ca7e1eec505b5e28744159343f` 创建独立开发候选，不改 main。

Based on the approved design PR #44, update actual M1 Lite UX while retaining all validated business logic.

### 已实施 / Implemented
- **报价回收**：导入方式聚焦切换（全部/文件/粘贴/单条）、紧凑默认列 / 完整列、逐条详情；“刷新显示”检测正在使用的导入/沿用预览，拒绝潜在破坏性重绘，其他情况下仅重绘并保留输入与滚动。
- **Quote intake**: Focusable input modes, compact/full columns, line details, and guarded view-only refresh.
- **比价议价**：决策概览→范围→逐物料表→金额分析；冗长规则折叠、报价单元格的交期/MOQ/轮次与商务条款改为按需展开、隐藏正式模式下重复的“历史采购价未接入”列，新增纯视图“仅看待决定”。
- **Comparison**: Decision-first layout, scoped analytics, secondary quote detail disclosures and pending-only view filter.
- **工作区/图纸/报表**：状态归并为一个简洁入口，技术日志按需展开；业务导出与数据恢复在管理区分组；图纸匹配步骤可见。
- **Workspace**: Compact status, separate report grouping and visible drawing-step guidance.

### 保护范围 / Safety
未改动 SQLite schema、报价轮次/版本计算、最低价并列及人工定标条件、Excel/PDF 内容、供应商隔离、S4 后端恢复规则。只修改正式 UI 及添加一个新的测试文件，不删除或修改既有测试/CI。

No persisted model, quote calculation, award logic, ZIP/PDF, exporter or S4 backend changes.

### 测试与门槛 / Validation gate
新增真实 Chromium + 隔离 SQLite E2E：录入方式切换、导入预览刷新保护、价单元格详情、紧凑模式、比较筛选、保存状态和数据管理分组。PR 创建后运行原 UI Unified / S3-S4 GitHub Actions 自动测试，**任何 CI 失败必须由 ChatGPT 排查修复；未通过前不交 Codex Cloud**。

When the exact final HEAD is CI-green, request one independent scoped TEST-ONLY Codex business/visual run (no full C03-C09 repetition). Keep this PR Draft, do not merge into baseline/main before independent acceptance and explicit owner approval.

## Follow-up repair after exact-SHA UAT — retest required

Product/test candidate now at exact HEAD `d7c4c88abd354ebdc5d3bfedfc9199e278c48483` (PR #46 remains Draft/unmerged). The Linux report for prior SHA `f8a67d72a3f798289067384a827e871ba16bca45` remains unchanged and NOT READY.

Implemented, not yet browser-verified:
- Help popovers now use viewport-fixed positioning, left/right clamping, above/below placement, maximum viewport height and internal scrolling; Escape dismisses even while the trigger is hovered/focused.
- Full-restore errors map known invalid-package, PDF-hash and non-empty-target cases to actionable Chinese. Raw backend details go to console diagnostics, not the buyer status.
- Updated stale E2E assertions to the current save/refusal/font/title tokens without removing business-state checks.
- Added real archive-as-full-restore rejection and ZIP_STORED tampered-PDF hash rejection tests before the positive full-restore control; added tooltip geometry/keyboard coverage at 1024/1366/1600.

Static checks only: 9 product inline scripts and 5 affected E2E files parse; all 407 DOM IDs remain unique. No actual tests have run on this SHA; the two P3s and six layout failures are **pending exact-SHA verification**, not closed. No Actions triggered (`[skip ci]`), no product merge.

Independent Codex should TEST-ONLY this exact SHA, run Python/Node/full Chromium plus independent UX/backup scenarios, retain PASS/FAIL/NOT TESTED and attach fresh evidence to existing Draft PR #50. Windows-native 3 groups remain NOT TESTED unless a real Windows runner is available.

- `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` 因 `su: Authentication failure` 退出1，安装命令为 **环境 BLOCKED**。使用仓库支持的 `SRM_CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium` 完整运行原测试，没有修改或跳过测试。Linux/Node24/Chromium154差异详见报告。
- 独立尝试1实际建立虚构12行/3供应商并保存，图纸预览正确显示唯一/多候选/未匹配；驱动误用“多候选”匹配实际“多个候选”标签而失败。保留原始错误后，使用唯一一次允许的独立驱动修正，在新空目录重跑。
- 尝试2遇异步XLSX控件尚未生成时的空节点 `.disabled` 访问错误，来源为独立 Playwright predicate。按最多一次修正规则停止，未第三次重跑或修产品。未执行的采购业务和独立三尺寸UI范围如实标NOT TESTED，图纸完整验收BLOCKED。
- 新确认产品P1/P2/P3缺陷0；两次FAIL均单列为驱动错误，不把未测范围推断为产品通过。
